title: ActionGate

summary: Pre-execution safety layer for autonomous agent wallets via MCP and x402.
offersHint: Pre-execution safety layer for autonomous agent wallets via MCP and x402. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.actiongate.xyz/mcp

toolsPreview.name: request_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Provision a prepaid ActionGate API key with $1.00 of starter credits for this operator email.

toolsPreview.name: balance
toolsPreview.description: Return the current prepaid credit balance and usage count for an ActionGate API key.

toolsPreview.name: top_up
toolsPreview.description: Generate a Stripe Checkout link so the human operator can add prepaid credits to an existing ActionGate API key.

toolsPreview.name: risk_score
toolsPreview.description: Score the risk of a proposed agent action before execution. Paid via x402 or API key credits. Free tier: 20 risk score calls/day per client.

toolsPreview.name: simulate
toolsPreview.description: Estimate cost, failure risk, and notable side effects for a proposed action. Paid via x402 or API key credits. Free tier: 20 simulate calls/day per client.

toolsPreview.name: policy_gate
toolsPreview.description: Apply treasury policy to a proposed action and return allow, deny, or allow-with-limits. Paid via x402 or API key credits. Free tier: 10 policy gate calls/day per client.
